_comment: Ground truth for the real-repos fixture (bytes + tokio + serde, built by scripts/demo-federation-fixture.sh). Three independent Rust libraries that share a toolchain but no service contract in LAIN's model. The ground truth is therefore 'no cross-repo Binds, no unresolved consumers' — i.e. precision=1.0 is the assertion. coverage_complete=true (all 3 repos indexed successfully) is the safety floor.
